subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should Google Chat Space activation stay strict to exact `botUser` annotation matching, or should the plugin treat delivered Space mention events as activation when Google has already routed the event to the app?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the durable fix changes group mention-gating semantics and could affect which Space messages are allowed into agent sessions.

options.title: Fix Exact Mention Detection And Diagnostics
options.body: Live-capture the current Google Chat annotation shape, update the plugin-local matcher and non-verbose diagnostics, and keep `requireMention` as the default group safety gate.

options.title: Accept Delivered Space Events As Mentions
options.body: Treat Google-delivered Space events as activation for service-account HTTP apps, relying on Google's delivery filter while preserving sender and group policy checks.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Work
options.body: Move the remaining behavior under the broader Google Chat Space/thread routing discussion if maintainers want one product decision for all Space semantics.

recommendation.title: Fix Exact Mention Detection And Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Live-capture the current Google Chat annotation shape, update the plugin-local matcher and non-verbose diagnostics, and keep `requireMention` as the default group safety gate.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checked-out implementation and access-policy path are attributed to Peter Steinberger in local blame, and this choice crosses plugin policy and group safety semantics.
